description: This is a shell script used to test the 'git-cvsserver' functionality, including handling of text and binary files, attributes, and repository operations in a version-controlled environment.

methods.name: marked_as
methods.description: Checks if a specific file in the CVS directory has the expected marking (-kb for binary), logs the check, and returns status.

methods.name: not_present
methods.description: Verifies that a particular file does not exist or is not marked, logs the verification.

methods.name: check_status_options
methods.description: Runs 'cvs status' with specified options and compares output to expected values, logs result.
